settings.title: Settings
settings.signOutConfirmBody: You'll need your mobile number and an OTP to sign in again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: Updates about your requests, bookings and support will appear here.

consents.title: Privacy & consents
consents.service_communications: Service updates by SMS and push
consents.marketingHint: Occasional offers. You can turn this off any time.
consents.intro: You control how Fix60 contacts you. Changes apply right away and are recorded with the date and policy version.
consents.requiredBody: You accepted these when you signed up. They are needed to provide the service.
consents.withdrawNote: To withdraw a required consent, delete your account from Settings.

deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.body: Your account will be deleted 7 days after you confirm. You can cancel during that time. Bookings and reports are kept without your personal details.
deletion.scheduledBody: You can keep using Fix60 until then. Choose “Keep my account” to cancel the deletion.
deletion.signOutHint: If you sign out now, sign in again before the date above to cancel.
deletion.finalBody: Your account will be deleted after 7 days. You can cancel any time before then.
deletion.kept: Deletion cancelled. Your account is safe.
deletion.pointProfile: Your profile, contact details and preferences are removed.
deletion.pointBookings: Past bookings, payments and safety reports are kept without your personal details, as required by law.
deletion.pointGrace: You have 7 days to change your mind.
deletion.pointSignIn: Active bookings should be completed or cancelled first.

support.title: Help & support
support.subject: Subject
support.contactBody: We usually reply within a few hours, 9 am – 7 pm.
support.noContacts: Contact details are not available right now. Create a request below.
support.emptyBody: Create a request and our team will reply here.
support.newTicketIntro: Tell us what happened. Our team will reply in this app.
support.resolvedNote: This request is resolved. Reply if you still need help.

errors.subject: Enter a short subject.
errors.message: Describe the problem in at least 10 characters.

report.title: Report a problem
report.submitted: Report {{code}} submitted. Our safety team will review it.
report.emergency: Leave the place if you can and call {{number}} (emergency services). Then tell us.
report.missingSubject: We couldn't tell who you want to report. Contact support instead.
report.detailsHint: What happened, when and where. Don't include passwords or bank details.
report.confidential: Reports are confidential. The person you report is not told who reported them.
report.blockFailed: We couldn't block {{name}}. Try again from Blocked users or contact support.
report.next1: Our safety team reviews every report, usually within 24 hours.
report.next2: We may contact you for details and may suspend the account while we check.
report.next3: Keep the report code above if you contact support.

block.confirmBody: You won't see each other in search or receive new requests from each other.
block.unblockConfirmBody: You may see each other in search and receive requests from each other again.
block.emptyBody: When you block someone, they appear here. You can unblock them at any time.
block.listIntro: Blocked people can't see you in search or send you new requests.

profile.phoneHint: This is your sign-in number. To change it, contact support.
profile.whatsappHint: Leave empty if it's the same as your mobile number.
profile.contactSupport: Need to change your number? Contact support

errors.email: Enter a valid email or leave it empty.
errors.locality: Choose your area, or clear the district.
